subject: Arts

questions.q: Which of the following is a common way contemporary artists in Nigeria generate income from their artworks?
options: By giving all artworks away for free to museums.
By organizing art exhibitions and selling their works to collectors.
By hiding their works in personal homes to increase their historical value.
By mass-producing artworks using foreign factories.
questions.explain: Organizing exhibitions in galleries is a primary method for artists to showcase their talent, attract patrons, and generate income through the direct sale of their artworks.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Nigerian Art Heritage & Pioneers
questions.subject: Arts

questions.q: When an artist is hired and paid by a client (like the government or a business) to create a specific artwork, this is called:
options: An auction
A charity event
An art commission
A royalty payment
questions.explain: A commission is a formal request and payment made to an artist to create a specific, custom piece of art. For example, a bank might commission a sculptor to build a statue for its headquarters.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Nigerian Art Heritage & Pioneers
questions.subject: Arts

questions.q: How can the promotion of contemporary Nigerian art benefit the broader economy of the country?
options: It completely replaces the need for agriculture.
It attracts international tourism and foreign exchange through art festivals and gallery visits.
It provides free housing for the population.
It stops citizens from traveling abroad.
questions.explain: A vibrant arts and culture scene boosts the economy by attracting local and international tourists who spend money on travel, accommodations, and purchasing artworks.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Nigerian Art Heritage & Pioneers
questions.subject: Arts

questions.q: When a contemporary Nigerian artist sells their painting through an organized public showing where buyers can bid or negotiate prices, this venue is typically called a(n):
options: Art Gallery or Exhibition
Traditional Shrine
Court of Law
Blacksmith's forge
questions.explain: Art galleries and public exhibitions are the primary commercial and cultural platforms where contemporary artists display and sell their artworks to generate income.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Nigerian Art Heritage & Pioneers
questions.subject: Arts

questions.q: Which of the following represents an indirect way contemporary art generates economic value for Nigeria as a country?
options: It increases the cost of imported rice.
It drives cultural tourism and earns foreign exchange when tourists visit festivals and galleries.
It forces citizens to pay higher income taxes.
It reduces the amount of clay available for farming.
questions.explain: A vibrant art sector attracts international tourists, art collectors, and cultural researchers, which boosts the local economy through tourism revenue and foreign exchange.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Nigerian Art Heritage & Pioneers
questions.subject: Arts

questions.q: Apart from selling finished artworks, which of the following is a common professional avenue for contemporary artists in Nigeria to earn a steady income?
options: Mining local tin for foreign export
Teaching as lecturers in university Fine Arts departments
Working as traditional herbalists
Refining crude oil into paint thinner
questions.explain: Many pioneer and modern contemporary artists (such as Clara Ugbodaga-Ngu, Yusuf Grillo, and Uche Okeke) worked as art educators and lecturers in universities, securing steady income while developing future artists.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Nigerian Art Heritage & Pioneers
questions.subject: Arts

questions.q: What is the primary purpose of an 'Art Auction' in the contemporary art market?
options: To destroy unappealing artworks in front of an audience.
To teach young children how to paint with watercolors.
To sell artworks to the highest bidder, generating significant income for the artist or gallery.
To test the chemical composition of antique paint.
questions.explain: An art auction is a public sale where artworks are sold to the person offering the highest price, serving as a major income generator and a way to establish the financial value of contemporary art.
